pieces.Text: A purrodaemon can sheathe a weapon in its flesh as a swift action.  This does no damage to the daemon.  If a weapon remains sheathed in its body for at least 24 hours, the weapon absorbs some of its essence and gains magical enhancements.  A purrodaemon can have up to a dozen weapons lodged in its body at a time, but only one can possess magical enhancements at a time.  The total enhancements cannot exceed a +4 effective enhancement - most purrodaemons opt to create +2 wounding weapons in this manner.  A weapon's enhancements vanish as soon as the purrodaemon dies or releases the weapon.  A purrodaemon gains Weapon Focus and Improved Critical as bonus feats as long as it wields a weapon benefiting from its weapon steep ability.
